title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. We are a remote-first company with a global team and a culture driven by integrity, accountability, and progress.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is committed to helping end users who need assistance.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks.
  • Support end users via channels such as Slack and Jira; own the first line of support.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; manage onboarding and offboarding of employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, tools and policies; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on identity providers and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage incidents and issues to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets and work on projects with agile methods.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows in Okta; strong API integration skills.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; capable of hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across media; clear, concise, and culturally sensitive communication.
  • Proficiency in documentation, tickets, emails, and Slack communications.
  • Strong problem-solving ability with knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs) and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Fit

We’re looking for a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values: act with integrity, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. A builder’s mindset, adaptability, resilience, and the ability to operate in ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment are highly valued. We value collaboration, empathy, and impact across functions and cultures.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting on day one; competitive PTO; ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote work opportunity worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven role with opportunities for growth in a global digital asset company.

About Our Environment & Application Process

Ledn is globally distributed with a remote-first culture. Due to high volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

EEO & Contact

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity and diversity. You may reach out for accommodation requests during all stages of the recruitment process at the designated email. Requests will be handled confidentially.

Seniority level: Mid-Senior level

Employment type: Full-time

Job function: Information Technology

Industries: Retail

Budget Management

  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.)
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

  • Experience with the integration of data from multiple data sources.

Responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing logistics activities related to international trade operations (imports and exports), third-party logistics (3PL) warehouse management, and national deliveries. Responsibilities

International Trade Coordination

Domestic Distribution Planning

  • Organize and supervise national distribution, including route planning and delivery schedules
  • Coordinate with carriers and logistics partners to ensure on-time and complete deliveries (OTD)
  • Manage transportation documentation and follow up on deliveries through to customer confirmation

Cost and Process Optimization

  • Analyze and optimize logistics costs related to storage, transportation, and customs
  • Propose and implement continuous improvements in distribution, warehousing, and trade operations
  • Negotiate rates and service terms with logistics and freight providers

Operational Monitoring and Control

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs): delivery times, route compliance, service levels, inventory turnover, etc.
  • Prepare logistics performance reports and present findings to senior management
  • Manage and resolve logistics incidents, including delays, product damage, returns, and losses

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate closely with purchasing, sales, customer service, and finance departments to align logistics operations with business goals
  • Communicate delivery timelines, operational constraints, and critical updates to internal teams and customers

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, International Trade, or related fields
  • 3–5 years of experience in logistics coordination roles, including international trade, 3PL operations, and national distribution
  • Knowledge of import/export processes and customs regulations
  • Proficiency in Incoterms, tariff classification, and trade agreements
  • Advanced English (written and spoken)
  • Experience with TMS and ERP systems – SAP / TOTVS Datasul

Preferred Requirements

  • Certification or diploma in logistics, supply chain management, or international trade
  • Strong analytical skills and experience with logistics cost analysis and KPI management
  • Operational leadership and strategic planning abilities
  • Problem-solving in logistics and supply chain environments
  • Effective communication and negotiation skills
  • Adaptability and stress management in dynamic contexts

Overview

Banco de Talentos Exclusivo para Pessoas com Deficiência | LM Mobilidade

Quer fazer parte de um dos maiores especialistas em mobilidade do país? Mesmo que você não tenha encontrado a vaga ideal, deixe seu currículo com a gente! Assim que surgir uma oportunidade alinhada ao seu perfil, entraremos em contato.

Na LM, valorizamos a diversidade, o protagonismo e a vontade de aprender. Estamos há quase 50 anos no mercado, oferecendo soluções em terceirização de frotas, assinatura de veículos, aluguel para motoristas e venda de seminovos. Fazemos parte do Grupo Volkswagen e atuamos em todo o Brasil.

Cadastre-se e venha com a gente transformar a mobilidade!

Nosso diferencial? #GenteNosImpulsiona

Valorizamos pessoas que atuam com colaboração , enfrentam desafios com responsabilidade e senso de dono , e que buscam sempre entregar o melhor com integridade . Pessoas que se conectam com o cliente, buscam empolgar , têm paixão pelo que fazem e enxergam cada dia como uma chance de crescimento .

Se você também acredita no poder da inovação , encara a complexidade como oportunidade e quer fazer parte de uma empresa em movimento constante, o seu lugar pode ser aqui.

  • Ser uma pessoa com deficiência (PCD);
  • Vontade de aprender e energia para fazer acontecer;
  • Abertura para trocar experiências e aprendizados;
  • Foco na experiência e encantamento do cliente;
  • Autonomia e responsabilidade no dia a dia.

Oferecemos oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência que buscam desenvolvimento e crescimento em diversas áreas:

MANUTENÇÃO

TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMAÇÃO

Temos escritórios em Salvador/BA, São Paulo/SP (Capital e SBC), Contagem/MG, Belo Horizonte/BH, Porto Alegre/RS, Curitiba/PR, Fortaleza/CE, Recife/PE e Cuiabá/MT.

Benefícios que fazem a diferença!

PLR (Bônus Anual): Reconhecimento pelo seu desempenho e pelos resultados da empresa.

Vale-Refeição e Vale-Alimentação

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico: Cuidado para você e sua família.

Desenvolvimento Profissional: Plataforma de educação corporativa.

Desconto em curso de inglês

Acesso a academias e atividades físicas via Wellhub .

Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida: Mais tempo para sua família.

E muito mais! Benefícios que garantem seu bem-estar e crescimento.

SOBRE A LM SOLUÇÕES DE MOBILIDADE

LM Mobilidade: conectando você e seu negócio

Há mais de 40 anos trabalhamos com foco em ser a melhor solução de mobilidade para pessoas e empresas. A LM Soluções de Mobilidade nasceu na Bahia através da veia empreendedora do seu fundador, Luiz Mendonça Filho, que transformou a empresa em uma das principais referências no setor, com atuação em todo o Brasil.

Em 2022 demos um grande passo rumo à expansão das nossas operações, através da combinação de negócios com a Volkswagen Financial Services, passamos a ser parte do Grupo Volkswagen. Além da experiência e domínio da operação, tão característica da LM ao longo dos anos, temos a segurança e a solidez de uma das marcas mais valiosas do mundo.

Hoje com a LM Soluções de Mobilidade oferecemos produtos e serviços totalmente personalizados para atender a necessidade de cada cliente, seja em terceirização de frotas, assinatura de veículos, venda de seminovos, aluguel para motorista de aplicativo ou mesmo assinatura de caminhões.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Security Engineers, Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. Ledn offers a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. Our team is a diverse group united by the conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy, and Ledn’s products & services can play a critical role in doing so. Our core values are integrity, accountability, progress, and empathy. We are building, innovating and revolutionizing financial services and invite you to join us.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. You will also design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

What You Will Do

  • Application Security: Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams; define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services; automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD; conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features; partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Authentication & Identity: Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications; enhance Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens); collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows; define secure session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves): Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads; integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs; migrate high-value operations into enclave environments; ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Additional Security Domains: Harden AWS services with least-privilege IAM and secure key management; improve Kubernetes security posture; deploy and operate a SIEM framework with detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks; support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • Minimum 10 years of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals; ability to remediate vulnerabilities identified in penetration test reports.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Have

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Experience on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Be adaptable and resilient, comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale information security practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company through shared equity.
  • Remote-friendly: work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose and removes barriers to doing your best work.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer and value inclusivity and diversity.

You may reach out with accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. Ledn is a remote-first environment with a globally distributed team across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response, and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please; we do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: SDR Pleno
description:
Overview

SOBRE A BUZZCREATORS
A Buzzcreators é uma plataforma brasileira especializada em conectar marcas com influenciadores, especialmente micro e nano influenciadores, para a criação e gestão de campanhas de marketing de influência. Ela oferece uma solução automatizada e baseada em dados para facilitar todo o processo, desde o planejamento até a execução e pagamento das campanhas.

Vaga - 100% HOME OFFICE

O que buscamos

O SDR em vendas (Sales Development Representative, ou Representante de Desenvolvimento de Vendas) terá a responsabilidade de identificar e qualificar leads, estabelecer contatos, criar oportunidades de negócio e auxiliar os times comerciais. Além disso, atuará na etapa pré-vendas, com habilidades específicas, antes de as vendas começarem.

Atividades

  • Prospecção ativa 100% focada em Outbound de empresas e agências interessadas e com potencial para se tornarem clientes Buzzmonitor;
  • Compreensão das necessidades/dores de negócio do cliente;
  • Apresentação de plataforma para solucionar essas necessidades;
  • Mapeamento de necessidades e potenciais projetos.

REQUISITOS

  • Ensino superior em andamento ou completo;
  • Experiência na posição de SDR/Inside Sales;
  • Experiência com metodologia de venda BANT;
  • Experiência com Google Docs ou Microsoft Office;
  • Experiência com processo outbound;
  • Experiência com criação de listas.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Técnica de vendas: Spin Selling;
  • Prospecção ABM;
  • Experiência no setor de Marketing Digital;

Manual QA / R + D em BairesDev

Estamos procurando por excelentes Manual QA para se juntar à equipe de pesquisa e desenvolvimento (P&D) da BairesDev. Nossa equipe de P&D é uma parte essencial de nossas soluções de tecnologia que geram milhões em receita todos os anos, por isso contratamos apenas os melhores dos melhores. Dentro da equipe, você encontrará muitos desafios diferentes: análise de dados, aprendizado de máquina, desktop e desenvolvimentos web são alguns dos mais relevantes no momento, mas para impulsionar a inovação, você notará que novidades estão surgindo todos os dias. A área de P&D é sem dúvida a área mais excitante e desafiante de toda a empresa. Apesar de pessoas realmente talentosas, em geral, formarem a BairesDev, aqui você encontra profissionais com larga experiência e também níveis intelectual e criativo muito acima da média. Queremos que as pessoas aproveitem a viagem. Você está pronto?

  • Analisar os requisitos do usuário final para definir e documentar planos de teste.

  • Conhecimentos adicionais em tecnologias Web.
  • Amplo conhecimento de ambientes Unix e Linux.
  • Nível avançado de inglês.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety

Remote - must be based in Brazil

At Platform Science, we’re working to connect everything that moves.

Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe.

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Engineering Manager to lead our Video Safety engineering team. This critical role involves overseeing the development and enhancement of our innovative video safety software product, designed to improve the safety of commercial truck drivers on the road. Our system utilizes in-cab dashcams to detect and report safety-critical events such as driver fatigue, close following, and lane departure warnings. These events are then reviewed by back-office administrators via a dedicated portal.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of high performance, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor and coach team members, providing regular feedback and supporting their professional growth and career development.
  • Implement and maintain high engineering standards, best practices, and processes across the team to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, and reliable software.
  • Coordinate and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and other engineering teams, to align on goals and deliver integrated solutions, working with a global team spanning North America, Europe, and Latin America (Brazil).
  • Oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Drive technical excellence and innovation, ensuring the team leverages appropriate technologies and architectural patterns.
  • Ensure the team's adherence to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining a focus on quality and user experience.
  • Act as a technical leader, providing guidance and expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS), backend development (Kotlin), and front-end technologies (React).
  • Champion a safety-first mindset within the engineering team, ensuring the product's features and performance directly contribute to safer driving practices.
  • Knowledge of Kotlin and Java

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred.
  • Experience in software development in a leadership or management role.
  • Proven experience managing and leading high-performing software engineering teams.
  • Strong technical proficiency in cloud platforms, specifically AWS, including services like EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others relevant to scalable applications.
  • Experience with front-end technologies, particularly React.
  • Demonstrated experience with scaled, high-availability systems.
  • Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum) and best practices.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of leading with empathy, fostering a positive team environment, and effectively managing individual and team performance.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with video processing, computer vision, or IoT applications is a plus.
  • Advanced/Fluent english is mandatory - written and speaking

Desired Attributes

  • Strategic Thinker: Ability to understand the broader business context and translate it into technical strategies and team goals.
  • Result-Oriented: Drives for measurable results and holds the team accountable for commitments.
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience.
  • Collaborative: A natural team player who builds strong relationships and fosters a cooperative work environment.
  • Passionate about Safety: Genuinely cares about the impact of our product on commercial truck driver safety.

Todas as pessoas candidatas qualificadas serão consideradas para nossa vaga, sem distinção de etnia, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, nacionalidade ou deficiência. Promovemos uma cultura de inclusão da diversidade e valorizamos as pessoas como nosso bem mais precioso. A Unicred promove a igualdade de oportunidades.

Vaga

Vaga para agência de Feira de Santana da Unicred Evolução.

Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar as atividades operacionais e de atendimento da agência, garantindo padrão de excelência e foco na melhoria contínua da experiência do cooperado;
  • Acompanhar e orientar a equipe nas rotinas diárias, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de aprendizado constante;
  • Atuar na comercialização de produtos e serviços financeiros, assegurando o cumprimento das metas e a satisfação dos cooperados;
  • Apoiar o Gerente de Agência e/ou Gerente de Relacionamento nas demandas estratégicas, podendo substituí-los quando necessário;
  • Garantir a qualidade operacional e o cumprimento das normas e procedimentos internos e legais vigentes;
  • Supervisionar a execução de processos financeiros e administrativos, incluindo controle de numerário, conferência de cheques e movimentações de caixa;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da agência e propor ações de melhoria contínua;
  • Apoiar o controle orçamentário e supervisionar a infraestrutura da unidade;
  • Desenvolver, capacitar e motivar a equipe, atuando como referência técnica e multiplicadora da cultura e dos valores da Unicred Evolução;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de segurança, compliance, saúde e segurança do trabalho, alinhadas às políticas corporativas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas afins;
  • Certificação CPA-10 (CPA-20 será um diferencial);
  • Rotinas administrativas;
  • Controle e fechamento de caixas;
  • Grafoscopia;
  • Administração e gestão de pessoal;
  • Pacote Office intermediário.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Auxílio Educação;
  • Auxílio Vestimenta;
  • Wellhub;
  • English Pass;
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR);
  • Bonificação de Alta Performance;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Benefícios em Produtos e Serviços exclusivos para colaboradores;
  • Incentivo certificações ANBIMA.

Premissas exclusivas para colaboradores da Unicred

  • Atenção aos requisitos mínimos da vaga: confira se você atende às qualificações necessárias antes de se candidatar;
  • Comunique sua liderança: informe sua intenção de participar do processo antes de formalizar sua candidatura;
  • Preenchimento na Gupy: não esqueça de marcar a opção "colaborador interno" ao se inscrever;

  • VR/VA, Vale Transporte, Assistência Médica e Odontológica e Auxílio Creche.
  • Gympass para bem-estar e saúde.

Modelo de Trabalho

Adotamos o modelo 100% remoto, proporcionando flexibilidade, enquanto mantém a interação virtual com a equipe para garantir uma colaboração eficaz e um ambiente de crescimento contínuo.

Se você busca um ambiente de crescimento e desafios, vem ser feliz!

description:

Nossa empresa está procurando por um profissional para liderar projetos globais e ser o(a) protagonista na definição do futuro de veículos icônicos em nossa unidade de Camaçari Bahia.

O cargo é perfeito para alguém que tem paixão por liderar, coordenar equipes multifuncionais e garantir que projetos complexos sejam entregues no prazo e dentro dos parâmetros estabelecidos.

Em nossa equipe, você terá um papel de liderança atuando como elo principal entre diversas áreas e regiões. Garantimos que nossos programas de veículos atinjam seus objetivos de sucesso.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar e coordenar projetos de ponta a ponta, garantindo o tempo, custo e escopo de cada programa.
  • Conduzir a coordenação entre times multifuncionais, incluindo Engenharia de Produto, PD, Manufatura, Compras, Finanças, Logística e Marketing.
  • Liderar investigações e estudos estratégicos para a viabilidade de futuros projetos, especialmente para o veículo Ranger.
  • Garantir a performance do programa com foco em: Prazo - Evitar atrasos mantendo o cronograma do projeto em dia; Custo - Assegurar que os custos não ultrapassem o orçamento previsto; Coordenação - Gerenciar com excelência a comunicação e as entregas de equipes multiregionais.

Qualificações e Conhecimentos Essenciais

  • Formação: Graduação em Engenharia ou Administração; Pós-graduação é desejável.
  • Experiência: Experiência comprovada em Gerenciamento de Programa e Gestão de Pessoas .
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Sólida experiência com metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos PMO.
  • Conhecimento de processos de desenvolvimento automotivo GPDS SPDS.
  • Certificação Six Sigma Green Belt ou Black Belt é um diferencial importante.
  • Idiomas: Inglês fluente é mandatório; Espanhol é desejável.
  • Diferenciais: Métodos Agile SCRUM e Experiência internacional.

Competências Comportamentais

Buscamos um(a) profissional que:

  • Demostre forte capacidade de trabalho em equipe.
  • Seja altamente organizado(a) e capaz de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades.

description:
Líder de Análise de Dados - Trabalho Remoto | REF#

Há mais de 15 anos, a BairesDev® é líder em projetos tecnológicos. Entregamos soluções inovadoras para gigantes como Google e Rolls-Royce e as startups mais inovadoras do Vale do Silício. Temos uma equipe diversa de mais de 4.000 profissionais formada pelo Top 1% dos talentos de tecnologia do mundo, trabalhando remotamente em cargos de impacto global. Ao se candidatar para este cargo, você está dando o primeiro passo em um processo que vai além do comum. Nosso objetivo é alinhar suas paixões, habilidades, e expectativas às nossas vagas, colocando você no caminho para desenvolver uma carreira de sucesso excepcional.

Líder de Análise de Dados na BairesDev

Estamos à procura de um Líder de Análise de Dados para se juntar à nossa equipe. Esse profissional será responsável por manter a integridade do nosso processo de dados, incluindo originação, aquisição, fluxo e processamento.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

  • Realizar análise de dados, navegar e revisar grandes conjuntos de dados, aprender e pesquisar funções de gerenciamento de dados de aplicativos e gerar relatórios.
  • Realizar investigações de monitoramento e alertas/escalonamento gerados pelo sistema relacionados a possíveis falhas no ambiente de serviço.
  • Interagir com engenheiros técnicos internos e fornecedores externos de terceiros para solucionar problemas e resolver problemas complexos.
  • Aplicar e desenvolver conhecimentos de tecnologia publicitária, especialmente operações de DSP, e processo de publicidade digital.
  • Ajudar a definir e testar automação de processos manuais.
  • Realizar acompanhamento diário, semanal e mensal de relatórios e fluxos de trabalho para garantir que as operações não sejam interrompidas.
  • Trabalhar entre equipes, como desenvolvimento, gerenciamento de produtos e grupos de finanças para pesquisar e resolver erros de cálculo de dados relatados pelo usuário.
  • Dar suporte às necessidades de faturamento financeiro, entendendo faturamento e relatórios em vários mercados/países, fornecendo suporte avançado a usuários internos e externos.
  • Criar, manter e documentar soluções de software/aplicativo e dados.

Esperamos Que Você Tenha

  • Licenciatura em Ciência da Computação ou Engenharia, Matemática ou Tecnologia.
  • 3+ anos de experiência de trabalho em uma função de gerenciamento de dados, suportando soluções de dados complexas.
  • Experiência de trabalho com análise de dados no setor de mídia de publicidade digital.
  • Experiência em liderar, orientar e auxiliar outros membros da equipe - a pessoa deve trabalhar extremamente bem em equipe e conseguir trabalhar em um ambiente multicultural e global com membros da equipe localizados remotamente.
  • Experiência de trabalho com SQL e habilidades avançadas de Microsoft Excel.
  • Capacidade de distinguir entre questões críticas e não críticas (forte capacidade de triagem e resolução de problemas).
  • Experiência de trabalho com as necessidades de Finanças e Faturamento.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Nível avançado de inglês.

Como tornamos seu trabalho (e sua vida) mais fácil

  • Modalidade 100% remota - trabalhe de qualquer lugar.
  • Excelente remuneração em USD ou na sua moeda local, como preferir.
  • Hardware para você trabalhar de casa.
  • Horários flexíveis - faça seu próprio horário.
  • Licença parental remunerada, férias, e feriados nacionais.
  • Ambiente de trabalho inovador e multicultural.
  • Colabore e aprenda com o Top 1% global dos talentos de cada área.
  • Ambiente de apoio com mentoria, promoções, desenvolvimento de habilidades, e diversas oportunidades de crescimento.

Você ama chocolate? Agora imagina trabalhar com essa gostosura!

Responsibilities

  • Reportando-se a Gerente de Trade Marketing, o Analista de Trade Marketing Canal Sr será responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias de trade marketing para a praça do estado de São Paulo, com uma perspectiva entre canais, visando aumentar a visibilidade da Hershey no ponto de venda e impulsionar o sell-out.

  • Elaboração de relatórios e apresentações de resultados para a alta gestão.

  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e Power Point;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de sell-out como Neogrid, Scanntech, Kantar e/ou Nielsen;
  • Habilidade analítica, capacidade de interpretar dados de mercado e identificação de oportunidades;
  • Perfil proativo com boa comunicação e relacionamento entre áreas / clientes;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em São Paulo, São Paulo, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, and/or Santa Catarina
  • Formato remoto e com disponibilidade para viajar 20%
  • Inglês ou Espanhol intermediários serão considerados diferenciais.

  • Desenvolvimento e execução de planos de trade marketing para todos os canais da praça de São Paulo, exceto Key Accounts;

  • Colaboração com equipes de vendas e marketing para alinhar estratégias e objetivos;

  • Monitoramento e avaliação da performance das campanhas de trade marketing;
  • Relacionamento com parceiros de canal e negociação de ações promocionais;

title: Agente de SAC III - E-commerce (Vestuário) - Sazonal
description:
Job description

Somos a 1° startup do Brasil a ter operações de Contact Center 100% no modelo home office.

Você é apaixonado por alcançar metas, está motivado a superar desafios e se colocar no lugar do outro enquanto faz parte de uma equipe dinâmica? Aqui é o seu lugar!!

Estamos à procura de profissionais dedicados, ambiciosos, apaixonados por alcançar metas e motivados a superar desafios para integrarem nossa equipe como Agentes de Atendimento, focados no SAC Multiskill para o e-commerce de uma marca de roupas e calçados.

Buscamos nos conectar com pessoas e aqui a gente preza pela igualdade de oportunidades e a inclusão da diversidade para todos os públicos. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades

  • Agente de solução em atendimento Multiskill via voz, ticket, e-mail e chat do e-commerce de uma rede de marcas de roupa de grife e calçados;
  • Você irá atender trocas e devoluções, estorno e reembolso;
  • Direcionar as reclamações e elogios recebidos aos setores/departamentos responsáveis;
  • Em todos os canais de comunicação é necessário ouvir atentamente o cliente buscando sempre o envolver, conduzir de forma prática o contato, possuir empatia, compreendendo a necessidade do cliente;
  • Nas mídias sociais será responsável por responder as reclamações e elogios dos clientes dos nossos anúncios.

Requisitos e habilidades

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Experiência com atendimento em SAC de vestuário/e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento básico no ramo da moda;
  • Possuir agilidade, escrita e dicção boa;
  • Experiência com atendimento em multicanais – voz, chat e e-mail;
  • Possuir habilidades em atuar no modelo home office;
  • Ter um espaço adequado para atuar home office (Mesa, cadeira e ambiente sem ruído);
  • Residir em São Paulo/ Grande São Paulo;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar presencial em escritório no bairro Vila Olímpia sempre que requerido pela empresa/liderança;
  • Possuir internet cabeada com mais de 10 MB (Sem utilizar o Wifi);
  • Habilidade em manusear diversos plataformas de trabalho (Zendesk, WhatsApp, Telefone, chat e Pacote Office).

Informação adicional

Escala de Trabalho: 6x1 – Horário a combinar de acordo com operação

Benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Auxilio Creche (Crianças de até 24 meses);
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • TotalPass;
  • Descontos em cursos, faculdade e parques de diversão.

Fornecemos Notebook, Mouse e Headset.

title: Principal Architect São Paulo, Brazil, Remote
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. The role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.

  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development:

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.

  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)

  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.

  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.

  • Architectural Knowledge:

    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.

    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).

  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.

  • Drive and Problem Solving:

    • A \"Whatever it takes\" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.

    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.

  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.

  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You''ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You''ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You''ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You''ll balance help desk tickets and prioritise them. You''ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you''re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You''ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You''ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you''re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it''s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone''s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You''re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We''re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder''s mindset, be a collaborative partner, influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and have remote work experience.

We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via equity.
  • The ability to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a company that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Please note, due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be adaptable to the evolving corporate infrastructure landscape and motivated to contribute to a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer-facing IT support and be the first line of support for employees via tools such as Slack and Jira.
  • Proactively manage Mac endpoints and enterprise environments; procure and deliver technology equipment; own the onboarding and offboarding experience.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and automation tools; contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to IDP/SSO improvements (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Write clear help articles, automate repetitive tasks, and manage incidents to resolution.
  • Prioritize help desk tickets and participate in project work within agile sprints (Jira). Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools and onboarding processes (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows; knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries and time zones; familiarity with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Strong communication skills across all media; ability to convey ideas clearly and support others without frustration.
  • Excellent written communication for tickets, email, and Slack.
  • Security-minded with knowledge of PGP and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching); familiarity with OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and collaborate across teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and CLI workflows.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies company values.

Culture and Benefits

We seek leaders who are adaptable, resilient, and collaborative; a builder’s mindset to create, iterate, and scale IT practices; integrity and accountability in handling confidential information; and experience working in remote environments.

We offer a comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one, including a competitive PTO package, stock ownership through equity, and remote-first policies allowing up to 180 days of remote work globally (subject to restrictions).

We are an equal opportunity employer and value inclusivity and diversity. Applicants may reach out for accommodation requests during the recruitment process; requests will be handled confidentially.

Location and Recruitment Notes

Location: Petrolina, Pernambuco, Brazil. We are a remote-first organization and may contact qualified applicants due to high volume. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; unsolicited agency resumes are not accepted.

Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn\'s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role and Responsibilities

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You\'ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You\'re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints). You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

You Bring to Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You\'ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you\'re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone\'s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit). You\'ve used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The ideal candidate will

Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day! We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines.   • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF).   • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. Chart abstraction activities and data collection Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.

About The Role

As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the entire user experience, from initial concept to final visual design. By turning customer insights into impactful and aesthetically pleasing designs, you’ll make our products more intuitive, self-servicing, and valuable. You will be responsible for the end-to-end design process, working closely with engineers and other stakeholders to deliver high-fidelity, implementation-ready designs ahead of schedule that are directly aligned with customer needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct 3 customer interviews with a Product Manager weekly to gather actionable feedback for design improvements.
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity prototypes using Figma that effectively communicate design concepts 2 sprints ahead of engineering timelines.
  • Develop and maintain a consistent and visually compelling UI across the entire platform.
  • Leverage data pipelines to inform and enhance design decisions.
  • Ensure all current products are intuitive and self-servicing for users.
  • Drive improved adoption and engagement across all current products.

What we’re looking for

  • Extremely curious and inquisitive, with a passion for understanding user needs.
  • Highly tech-savvy and comfortable designing for complex systems.
  • A deep, almost spiritual design philosophy that prioritizes the customer experience.
  • Skilled in conducting customer interviews and synthesizing insights into actionable designs.
  • Proven expertise in UI design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work with design systems, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Quick learner who can master the industry and product in a short time.
  • Extensive knowledge of design principles, UX/UI best practices, and proficiency in modern design tools.
  • Relentless work ethic: willing to go the extra mile (10+ hours daily when needed).
  • No ego and a mindset of continuous learning and collaboration.
  • Builds genuine relationships with team members and customers.
  • Positive, motivating, and supportive team player.
  • Accountable for successes and failures, with a focus on doing the job right.
  • Balances leadership with hands-on contributions (player-coach mentality).
  • Passionate about AI and its potential to transform industries

What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

Why Join XILO?

Be part of a mission-driven team at the forefront of AI innovation and SaaS technology. As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll have the opportunity to own the user experience and interface of a cutting-edge platform, deliver career-defining work, and make a lasting impact on a rapidly growing company.

At XILO, we don’t stop until the job is done. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, embrace challenges, and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply only if you’re ready to invest in your success and build a lasting career.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN . Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Ledn’s team is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds, with a shared conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn’s products and services can play a critical role in doing so. Our core values are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • You will be customer-facing, the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.
  • You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.). You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’ll juggle help desk tickets and prioritize them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in Jira (agile methods and sprints).
  • You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and align them to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS and experience with GAM and command-line interfaces.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture Fit: We look for a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies our values.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer remote work flexibility up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and opportunities for growth. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

Working Environment

  • Ledn is global and remote-first. Our people span North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
