title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Information Technology Manager at LEDN – join us and help drive our IT and cybersecurity efforts in a fast-growing, remote-first environment. Ledn is a global financial services company focused on digital assets, with products and services in over 150 countries.

We are seeking an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate wears many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. The right person will be passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while delivering a high-quality support experience to our employees.

Responsibilities

  • Be the first line of support for employees, providing outstanding help via Slack, Jira, and other channels; act as customer-facing IT representative.
  • Own IT operations: support end users, manage endpoints (Mac-centric environment), and administer cloud-based IT systems.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding for new employees and offboarding/offboarding processes.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • Manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and IT security tooling.
  • Oversee Mac endpoint management and mobile device management (MDM/EMM) tooling (e.g., Jamf).
  • Own and improve identity, device provisioning, and SSO integrations (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks; manage incidents to resolution.
  • Prioritize help desk tickets; work on projects with agile methods and sprints in Jira.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.; experience with open-source tooling (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows within Okta; strong API integration skills.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; capable of handling hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and ability to craft clear help content; security-conscious mindset (e.g., knowledge of PGP).
  • Networking basics and problem solving across OSI layers; ability to self-manage and scope projects across teams.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and CLI tools.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: entrepreneurial, adaptable, resilient, and able to navigate ambiguity in a high-growth environment.

Culture and Benefits

  • Remote-first environment with options to work remotely up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions); equity opportunities; competitive total rewards package and PTO.
  • Equal opportunity employer; inclusive and diverse culture; confidentiality in handling information; accommodation requests can be directed to the Ledn team.

Note: Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. No agencies or recruiters, and unsolicited resumes will not be accepted.

The Opportunity: We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate supports end users, manages endpoints, automates identity and access management, and administers cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate has demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments and is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code. You should be adaptable, a strong communicator, and excited to grow IT skills in a fast-moving, execution-oriented team.

What You’ll Do

You will be customer-facing and serve as the first line of support, owning the support experience for employees via tools such as Slack and Jira. You’ll work in a Mac environment, troubleshooting, using the terminal, and ensuring macOS works in the enterprise. Responsibilities include procuring and delivering technology equipment, owning the tech onboarding process for new employees, and the tech retrieval process for departing employees. You’ll design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM, EMM, Jamf). You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta), document solutions, craft help articles, and automate repetitive tasks. You’ll manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents as needed, and balance help desk tickets while prioritizing tasks. You’ll work on projects over sprints, detailing work in Jira and practicing agile methods. You’ll set and pursue your own objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

You will report to the Director of IT.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, NetSuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; experience with APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent communication across all media; clear ideas and calm under pressure; strong writing skills for tickets, email, and Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, concise writing; sensitivity to different cultures; a proactive, customer-focused mindset.
  • Security awareness, including understanding of PGP; basic networking fundamentals and troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model).
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.

Nice to Have: Familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications; startup/remote environment experience.

Culture & Fit

Ledn seeks a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment, with a builder’s mindset, adaptability, empathy, integrity, and accountability. We value collaboration across functions and cultures and remote work experience.

What We Provide

Ledn provides growth opportunities and a comprehensive total rewards package starting from day one. Benefits include a competitive PTO package, remote work eligibility worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions), and equity ownership in the company. We are an equal opportunity employer and value inclusivity and diversity. For accommodation requests throughout the recruitment process, please contact the Ledn team via email. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Working Environment

Ledn is truly global with team members across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote-first organization. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, and no unsolicited resumes.

title: Product Manager, Lending
description:
Overview

Clutch is on a mission to transform Credit Unions into fintechs — helping them deliver digital experiences that rival the best banks and lenders in the world.

As a Product Manager on the Lending Application Intake team, you’ll support the core member application experience that powers our lending platform. You’ll work closely to deliver small features that improve the speed, accuracy, and usability of loan applications — from initial intake through decisioning.

This is a hands-on learning role where you’ll develop the fundamentals of product management within a fast-paced fintech environment. You’ll learn how digital lending works, how credit unions serve their members, and how to turn complex workflows into simple, delightful product experiences, driving impact to our credit union customers and their members.

About the Team

You’ll join a high-talent density Product & Engineering org with a culture of ownership, speed, and judgment. PMs here work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and GTM peers, driving clarity and tough tradeoffs instead of waiting for direction.

This is a pivotal time at Clutch: we are on a strong growth path, and how we scale account opening in the next 12 months will define how Clutch builds durable company leverage.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Learn the fundamentals of Clutch’s Digital Lending experience, workflows, and customer personas.
  • Partner with a Senior PM and triad partners (Design + Engineering) to deliver small features and improvements end-to-end.
  • Collaborate with engineering to validate features and ensure quality delivery.
  • Shadow customer calls and internal standups to understand how fintech products serve real-world credit union needs.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Contribute to backlog refinement, writing crisp product specs, and maintaining feature documentation.
  • Own a well-defined part of our product and lead quarterly planning for it with guidance from your manager.
  • Analyze user feedback and product data to inform backlog prioritization.
  • Present updates in demos and share learnings with your peers.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Independently manage a small product area or recurring improvement track
  • Develop the ability to independently identify, scope, and propose enhancements that drive measurable customer impact.
  • Turning urgent needs into repeatable, scalable systems
  • Demonstrate growth in product judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and ownership mindset.

What You’ll Bring

  • Execution excellence : Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments; you bring urgency, energy, and follow-through. A strong signal is 2+ years of PM experience in B2B or fintech environments.
  • Collaboration skills : You partner across product, engineering, and GTM — holding the line on judgment while ensuring customers feel heard.
  • Growth mindset: A growth mindset and willingness to receive and act on feedback to improve quickly.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility : Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.
  • Unforgettable Off-Sites : Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays : Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Stock Options : Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup : Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget : Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note : This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI at Clutch : We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

Company Overview

Company Overview: When the manufacturing community faces dimensional metrology challenges, they turn to Mahr Inc., headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island, and a member of the Mahr Group. Providing solutions for more than 160 years, we manufacture and support an extensive portfolio of solutions—from handheld gages to systems which measure contours, forms, surface finishes, lengths, and non-contact optical metrology technologies. We empower manufacturers within all industries like aerospace, automotive, medical, optical, and more to achieve unparalleled accuracy and efficiency in their measurement processes. Mahr Inc. is also a well-known provider of calibration and contract measurement services with laboratory accreditations ISO/IEC 17025:2005 and NVLAP Lab Code -0.

Position Overview

Position: SALES ENGINEER located in the Denver, CO area to highlight their technical sales talents within the WEST district (Colorado, Nevada, Utah, Arizona, New Mexico and possibly Northern, CA ). Denver, CO is the ideal location for this position, but we’re willing to consider candidates that live in any large city in the district, that is in close proximity to a major airport and willing to travel up to 100%. This position reports to the West Regional Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Metrology Equipment , be self-directed, have a resourceful spirit, and the focus required to deepen market share within the assigned region.

Responsibilities

  • Territory Management: Develop and execute sales plans for the assigned district, identify current key accounts while placing a strong emphasis on cultivating new customers within existing and emerging market segments.
  • Customer Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with prospects and customers to understand their needs and offer the appropriate tailored solutions. Regular air travel (60% to 80% of the time, including overnights) within the district territory.
  • Channel Partners: Support and educate the distribution network with ongoing technical assistance, quotes, new product updates, demonstrations, and promotions, to ensure they are prepared to successfully promote the Mahr brand.
  • Product Knowledge: Stay in tune with industry trends, competitor activities, and new product developments to effectively position Mahr metrology equipment in the market.
  • Forecasting: Daily utilization of Salesforce CRM, create opportunities, events, tasks for all activities related to engagement and management of the district.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing, customer support, and product development, to ensure a cohesive and customer-centric outcome.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2 years of proven outside sales experience within dimensional metrology or closely related industry (outside sales experience of industrial capital equipment will also be considered).
  • Leadership skills to support distribution channels and representative personnel is preferred.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and selling skills, along with the ability to create and develop lasting relationships with both customers and colleagues.
  • High level of self-motivation with the ability to work independently as well as within a team.
  • Based from your home office, must be able and willing to travel up to 80% of the time, within the assigned district.
  • Compensation – base salary plus performance-based incentives
  • Comprehensive benefits:
    • Subsidized medical insurance
    • Company contribution to Flex Spending Account (FSA)
    • Life insurance included for employee, additionally available for dependents
    • Short-term disability included for employee
    • Available dental and vision insurance for employees/dependents
    • Available long-term disability, accident, hospital indemnity and critical illness insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Company Automobile
  • Credit card for fuel and business travels expenses
  • Computer and mobile phone
  • Paid time off includes holidays, vacation, and sick time.

If you are a determined and enthusiastic individual, with results in metrology equipment sales, we invite you to apply for this stimulating opportunity to utilize and expand your skills towards continuing the success of a leader in the metrology industry.

description:
Overview

Information Technology Manager role at LEDN . Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. Our team is a passionate group from diverse backgrounds, guided by values to act with integrity, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building, innovating and revolutionizing financial services.

The Opportunity: We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while also helping end users who need assistance. You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). This role reports to the Director of IT.

Overview of the role includes customer-facing responsibilities as the first line of support and ownership of the support experience for employees via tools such as Slack and Jira. We primarily operate on macOS in our environment and you will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment, onboarding new employees, and offboarding departing employees. You will design, test, build, document programs and policies, and contribute improvements to our knowledge base. You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools. You will contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) and document solutions, help articles, and automated workflows. You will manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents, balance help desk tickets, and participate in projects across sprints using Jira and agile methods.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open-source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta. Knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Exceptional communication skills across all media; ability to convey ideas clearly and support users who are time-poor or frustrated.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email, and Slack communications.
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching) and OSI model layers; methodical troubleshooting approach.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have : Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and CLI tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit : We value leadership that thrives in startup or tech environments and embodies our values of progress, integrity, collaboration and empathy. A builder’s mindset to create, iterate, and scale IT practices; ability to influence across functions; and a track record of integrity and accountability in handling confidential information.

The Benefits We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package that starts on day one, including a competitive PTO package.
  • Equity ownership via shared equity, giving employees a stake in the company.
  • Remote-ready work arrangements, with up to 180 days remote work worldwide (subject to restrictions).

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity. For accommodation requests throughout the recruitment process, please email the Ledn team. Requests will be handled confidentially.

Location : Blumenau, Blumenau area, Brazil and other global locations. We are remote-first and may contact only qualified applicants due to high volume. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available relevant social media activity. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role Details

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.). You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You'll set and work to your own objectives and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (not required to have certifications).
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to work efficiently.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture Fit: a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has a passion for progress, adaptability, resilience, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Has a builder's mindset, is excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Is a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Has worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting from day one.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company; through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the future.
  • Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a culture that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity.

Additional Information

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. Our team is global and remote-first. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Atuará de forma integrada aos times de Produto e Tecnologia, conduzindo a experiência de ponta a ponta — da concepção à entrega — com coerência entre jornadas, interfaces, estados e conteúdo, e registrando comparativos “antes/depois” que sustentem decisões executivas.

  • Articular decisões com Produto e Engenharia, apresentando raciocínio, protótipos e evidências que sustentem escolhas técnicas e de experiência.
  • Documentar e apresentar resultados com comparativos “antes/depois” (ex.: redução de atritos, erros e etapas; aumento de completude de tarefas; diminuição de chamados de suporte).

  • Vivência com Design System em produto vivo (versionamento, contribuição e gestão de estados críticos).

  • Familiaridade com DesignOps (ritmos, governança, critérios de qualidade) e condução de críticas de design.
  • Conhecimento aplicado de acessibilidade (WCAG 2.2 AA).
  • Comunicação clara para articular trade-offs com Produto e Tecnologia e defender decisões de forma estruturada.

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while also helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable, creative in problem solving, and able to work in a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. This role reports to the Director of IT.

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via tools like Slack and Jira. We predominantly work on macOS, and you will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment, onboarding new employees, and offboarding departing employees. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools. You will detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix incidents as needed. You will work on projects over sprints, and document your work in Jira. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn :

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; knowledge of API integrations between systems.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; clear, friendly, and concise writing.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting, macOS enterprise configuration, and technical onboarding/offboarding processes.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and OSI model; ability to troubleshoot methodically.
  • Self-management with clear scoping of projects and priorities across multiple teams.

Nice to Have : Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

  • Liderança na Estratégia e Coleta de Dados: Liderar a identificação, avaliação e extração de dados de fontes complexas e variadas (bancos de dados, APIs, data lakes), definindo as melhores práticas e garantindo a integridade e relevância dos dados para as análises estratégicas.

  • Inovação e Pesquisa: Pesquisar e implementar novas tecnologias, metodologias e abordagens em análise de dados e machine learning, mantendo a empresa na vanguarda das práticas do mercado.
  • Precisamos Que Você Tenha
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou mestrado em áreas relacionadas a dados será considerado um diferencial.

  • Expertise em Ferramentas de BI (Power BI e Looker Studio): Domínio completo de pelo menos uma das ferramentas (preferencialmente ambas) para criar dashboards complexos, interativos e de alto impacto.
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados (DAX no Power BI) e integração de múltiplas fontes de dados.
  • Programação em Python para Análise de Dados: Proficiência em Python e suas principais bibliotecas de dados (Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experiência na automação de processos, manipulação de grandes volumes de dados e integração com APIs.
  • Conhecimento Estatístico Aplicado: Sólida compreensão de conceitos estatísticos e sua aplicação prática em negócios (testes A/B, análise de regressão, testes de hipóteses) para validar resultados e gerar insights mais profundos.
  • Google Workspace (Planilhas e Apresentações): Habilidade para ir além do uso básico, utilizando Google Sheets para análises rápidas e prototipagem, e Google Slides para comunicar resultados complexos de forma clara e persuasiva para a liderança.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de solucionar problemas técnicos complexos com autonomia.

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is a diverse group united by the belief that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy. Ledn operates with the values: act with integrity, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building, innovating and revolutionizing financial services.

The Opportunity: We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate wears many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated success in similar roles within security-first, rapidly growing environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and enjoys helping end users who need assistance.

Responsibilities

  • Be the first line of support for employees, providing outstanding support via Slack, Jira, and other tools.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment and manage onboarding/offboarding experiences for staff.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, and related services.
  • Manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and improve IDP and SSO integrations (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, write help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents to completion; prioritize help desk tickets and manage projects in sprints (agile).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; experience with open source tooling (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows; proficient with APIs and system integrations.
  • Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; experience shipping and receiving hardware and handling customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and OSI troubleshooting; knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • Self-management skills with the ability to scope projects and coordinate across teams.

Nice to Have / Culture Fit

  • Familiarity with AWS; experience using GAM and CLI to improve efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications; strong ability to adapt in a startup/tech environment.
  • Demonstrated integrity, accountability, and the ability to work in a remote setting.

Benefits and Environment

  • Competitive total rewards package; paid time off; ownership via equity; remote work flexibility up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose in a globally leading digital asset company; inclusive, diverse environment; equal opportunity employer.

Application and Notes

You may reach out for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. We are remote-first and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de segurança: projetar e garantir a implementação de arquiteturas de segurança robustas e escaláveis para aplicações e infraestrutura em ambientes Multi Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), alinhadas com as melhores práticas de mercado e requisitos regulatórios.
  • Apoiar no design seguro de sistemas: trabalhar com Arquitetos de Software e equipes de desenvolvimento para integrar segurança desde as etapas iniciais do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (Secure SDLC), realizando análises de ameaças (Threat Modeling) e revisões de design.
  • Garantir a segurança em ambientes Cloud e Contêineres: implementar e otimizar controles de segurança para plataformas Cloud (principalmente GCP, incluindo GKE, Cloud SQL), redes (VPCs, firewalls, micro-segmentação) e ambientes conteinerizados (Kubernetes), assegurando conformidade e proteção de dados.

  • Assegurar conformidade e auditoria: atuar para que as soluções estejam em conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentações externas (ex: LGPD, Bacen para clientes do setor financeiro), preparando ambientes para auditorias de segurança.
  • Documentar e disseminar conhecimento: criar e manter documentação técnica de segurança, padrões e guidelines, e atuar como referência para o time em decisões técnicas de segurança.
  • Visão estratégica e melhoria contínua: contribuir com a visão estratégica de segurança, identificar tendências e novas ameaças, propondo melhorias para a postura de segurança dos ambientes.

Qualificações / Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em Arquitetura de Segurança de aplicações e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento profundo em plataformas Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), com foco em serviços de segurança nativos (ex: Security Command Center, Security Hub, GuardDuty, WAF).
  • Domínio de Kubernetes Security (RBAC, Network Policies, image scanning, runtime security).
  • Experiência com DevSecOps e integração de segurança no pipeline de desenvolvimento.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e padrões de segurança (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, OWASP Top 10, Zero Trust).
  • Conhecimento em IAM, gestão de segredos, criptografia e proteção de dados.
  • Habilidade para Threat Modeling e análise de riscos.
  • Boa comunicação e proatividade para interagir com equipes multidisciplinares e stakeholders.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações de segurança (ex: CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, GCP Security Engineer, AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500).
  • Experiência em segmentação de rede, VPNs e SD-WAN para ambientes híbridos e multi-cloud.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de segurança como SIEM/SOAR, CSPM e Vulnerability Scanners.
  • Experiência com automação de segurança via scripting (Python, Shell).
  • Histórico de atuação em clientes do setor financeiro e familiaridade com Bacen e LGPD.

Mahr Inc. is also a well-known provider of calibration and contract measurement services with laboratory accreditations ISO/IEC 17025:2005 and NVLAP Lab Code -0.

We are seeking a DISTRICT SALES MANAGER located in the Seattle, WA or Portland, OR areas to highlight their technical sales talents within the Pacific Northwest (Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Montana, Wyoming and possibly Northern CA) . Responsibilities

  • Strong communication, negotiation and selling skills, along with the ability to create and develop lasting relationships with both customers and colleagues.
  • High level of self-motivation with the ability to work independently as well as within a team.
  • Based from your home office, must be able and willing to travel up to 70% of the time, within the assigned district.
  • Compensation – base salary plus performance-based incentives
  • Comprehensive health insurance and wellness benefits:
    • Subsidized medical insurance
    • Company contribution to Flex Spending Account (FSA)
    • Life insurance included for employee, additionally available for dependents
    • Short-term disability included for employee
    • Available dental and vision insurance for employees/dependents
    • Available long-term disability, accident, hospital indemnity and critical illness insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Company Automobile
  • Credit card for fuel and business travels expenses
  • Computer and mobile phone
  • Paid time off includes holidays, vacation, and sick time.

If you are a determined and enthusiastic individual, with results in metrology equipment sales, we invite you to apply for this stimulating opportunity to utilize and expand your skills towards continuing the success of a leader in the metrology industry.

  • Conhecimento de frameworks de vendas (SPIN, BANT, GPCT, etc.);

Não é obrigatório, mas, adoramos se você tiver:

What You Bring to Ledn

  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages.
  • Proven ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS (no certifications required).
  • Experience with GAM and CLI work to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership aligned with startup/tech environment values.

Our culture and expectations

  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially with confidential information.

Join to apply for the Senior Product Designer role at Flex

This range is provided by Flex. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$65,000.00/yr - $90,000.00/yr

  • Collaborative to your core. You communicate early and often, working as one team with product, engineering, and leadership to move in the same direction
  • Thoughtful and opinionated. You have taste — and the conviction to advocate for it — while staying open to feedback and iteration
  • Mission-oriented. You care deeply about helping business owners succeed, and you bring that empathy to every decision you make

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience designing and shipping digital products end-to-end. A sharp eye for craft, detail, and delight — you care about the last 10%. Experience building, using, and evolving design systems that scale across teams
  • Comfort with ambiguity — you clarify problems, define strategy, and move teams forward
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills that influence across product, engineering, and leadership
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with ambitious goals and high standards

Nice to Have

  • Coding experience, specifically React
  • Motion, animation, or interaction design skills
  • Strength in visual identity or brand expression
  • Familiarity with fintech or complex business systems

Interested?

We’d love to hear from you

At Flex, we value passion, determination, and honesty. Even if you don\'t fully match the job specifics, we encourage you to apply. Unusual career paths and unique skills can help you stand out. We believe diversity drives our success.

Why Join Us

Flex is growing quickly — you’ll help shape the direction of a product and company with real momentum.

We’re well-capitalized with strong backing and a clear long-term vision.

You’ll work with a sharp, driven team that values autonomy, clarity, and quality.

Join ambitious builders who care deeply about winning together — and having fun while doing it.

Annual team on-sites. From Bogota to Mexico City, the entire Flex team gets together once a year to align and build camaraderie.

Overview

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is committed to helping end users who need assistance.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, and be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving, highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer-facing IT support and be the first line of support for employees via Slack, Jira, and other tools.
  • Manage procurement and delivery of technology equipment; own the onboarding experience for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on identity and access management tools (IDP and SSO; e.g., GSuite, Okta).
  • Detail solutions in help articles and automate routine tasks; respond to and resolve critical incidents.
  • Prioritize help desk tickets and work on projects over sprints using agile methods.
  • Set and work toward objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open-source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows in Okta; API integration between systems.
  • Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; ability to ship and receive hardware and manage customs.
  • Exceptional communication skills across mediums and the ability to explain complex concepts clearly; strong writing skills.
  • Strong security mindset; knowledge of PGP; networking fundamentals and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams; comfortable with ambiguity.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and CLI tools.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

  • We are an equal opportunity employer and value inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

  • Purpose-driven work in a leading digital asset company.

INTUS Windows is seeking a detail-oriented and systems-savvy NetSuite Accountant to manage the entry, accuracy, and validation of accounting data within our NetSuite ERP platform. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in accounting, hands-on NetSuite experience, and enjoys a structured, process-driven environment. Qualifications

What We Offer

Job Description

Candidates must be fluent in English and submit their application in English to be considered.

Only those currently living in and authorized to work in Brazil are eligible. The application system will store candidate information. Once submitted, application details will be shared with Church Education System (CES) partners involved in the selection process. Applicants may receive a rejection email during or after review; however, unless a direct rejection is received from the hiring manager, applications will remain active and under consideration.

Responsibilities

  • The Computer Programming Course Instructor is an important part of the instructional team. With a strong focus on the academic success of every student, instructors use their subject matter expertise, deep understanding of the curriculum, and student population to:
  • Identify trends impeding academic success.
  • Conduct targeted outreach and provide instruction to target groups and individuals.
  • Build capable learners, confident in their ability to succeed academically and in life.
  • Instructors do not develop lessons or assessments, nor do they issue grades on student work (grading is handled by a centrally managed pool of qualified Graders).
  • Their focus is on the academic success of every student in their care.

Important: This is a part-time work-from-home position with the following flexible schedule:

  • 10-12 hours per week (may vary week-to-week)
  • At least 5 days worked each week
  • Required attendance at periodic team meetings (as established by the department)

Course Description

Teaching and mentoring students (using Python and C#) for:

  • CSE 110 - Introduction to Programming
  • CSE 111 - Programming with Functions
  • CSE 210 - Programming with Classes
  • CSE 212 - Programming with Data Structures

These courses provide students with foundational computer programming skills, enabling them to contribute to software development teams.

Position Summary

BYU Pathway and BYU Idaho online courses are structured to include both an instructor and graders. Instructors are responsible for teaching and overall course delivery, while graders support the learning process by reviewing and evaluating assignments and providing students with constructive feedback. We are seeking instructors who will apply their skills and subject matter expertise to mentor students and facilitate teaching/learning experiences.

Qualifications

NOTE : An applicant’s résumé and official transcripts will be used to determine eligibility to serve as an instructor for the Computer Programming courses. Please clearly highlight relevant education, professional work, and technologies on your résumé.

General Instructor Requirements

  • Deep understanding of and commitment to BYU Pathway Worldwide’s mission, defining characteristics, and student population.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (required).
  • Adaptability to new processes, procedures, and technologies.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills: professional, respectful, and unbiased in sensitive situations.
  • Proven reliability and ability to meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, video conferencing, and discipline-specific software.
  • Experience with online teaching/learning, especially with at-risk learners (preferred).

Specific Course Requirements: Computer Programming

  • A master’s degree in computer science or a related field and two years of professional software development experience is preferred.
  • A bachelor’s degree and 3-5 years of work experience may be considered.
  • Experience with Python, C#, or Java is required.
  • Expert proficiency with basic programming concepts, such as variables, data types, collections, loops, functions, libraries, I/O, error handling, and testing.
  • Expert proficiency with basic object-oriented programming concepts, such as classes, methods, variables, and access modifiers.
  • Familiarity with data structures and algorithms.
  • Understanding object-oriented principles, such as abstraction, encapsulation, polymorphism, and inheritance.
  • Experience with version control software, such as GitHub.
  • Experience with code editors, such as Visual Studio Code.
  • Ability to communicate clearly in writing.

Additional Documentation Requirement

Candidates advancing to the next stage of the hiring process will be required to provide the following academic documents:

  • Official transcript (histórico escolar) of a completed bachelor’s or master’s degree. The transcript must be sent directly from the awarding institution, either in digital or physical format. Transcripts submitted by the candidate, regardless of format, will not be considered official for accreditation or academic credential verification purposes. This process may take time and may involve additional expenses, depending on the institution.
  • Copy of diploma (front and back) showing the date of degree completion or the date of the graduation/commencement ceremony (data da colação de grau).

Academic documents issued by Brazilian or international institutions are acceptable, provided they are officially recognized in Brazil and the country of origin (Bacharelado, Licenciatura, Mestrado, Mestrado Profissional). Not applicable: in-progress transcripts and associate-level degrees. A completed bachelor’s degree is the minimum requirement for this position.

Documentação Adicional Requerida

Os Candidatos Que Avançarem Para a Próxima Etapa Do Processo Seletivo Deverão Apresentar Os Seguintes Documentos Acadêmicos

  • Histórico escolar oficial de bacharelado ou mestrado concluído.
  • O histórico deve ser enviado diretamente pela instituição de ensino responsável pela titulação, em formato digital ou físico.
  • Históricos enviados pelo próprio candidato, independentemente do formato, não serão considerados oficiais para fins de credenciamento ou verificação de títulos acadêmicos.
  • Observe que este processo pode demandar tempo e gerar custos adicionais.
  • Cópia do diploma (frente e verso) que comprove a data de conclusão do curso ou a data da colação de grau.

Serão aceitos documentos acadêmicos emitidos por instituições brasileiras ou estrangeiras, desde que reconhecidos oficialmente no Brasil e no país de origem (Bacharelado, Licenciatura, Mestrado, Mestrado Profissional).

Não serão aceitos históricos de cursos em andamento e diplomas de nível tecnólogo. O requisito mínimo para esta vaga é um bacharelado concluído .

Tech manager infosec seguranca da informacao

Quem somos

Na Qive, simplificamos o complexo para impulsionar o crescimento das empresas no Brasil. Transacionamos mais de 3,8 bilhões de notas fiscais e conectamos mais de 140 mil empresas, criando um elo poderoso entre o fiscal e o financeiro. Desde o início, projetamos soluções digitais que revolucionam o dia a dia das pessoas e empresas, sempre com a missão de tornar processos complexos mais simples, eficientes e eficazes.

Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo.

Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Gestão de Equipes de InfoSec: Liderar, motivar e desenvolver o time de segurança, garantindo excelência técnica e evolução de carreira;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Conformidade: Mapear riscos, acompanhar auditorias e manter os controles de segurança atualizados, mitigando vulnerabilidades em sistemas, processos e fornecedores;
  • Estratégia de Segurança: Definir e implementar a visão de InfoSec, alinhando práticas de segurança da informação aos objetivos de negócio e compliance (ISO 27001 e LGPD);
  • Resiliência Operacional: Estabelecer planos de resposta a incidentes, post mortems de falhas e priorização de soluções de longo prazo;
  • Arquitetura Segura: Apoiar times de engenharia e produto na definição de soluções resilientes e seguras, garantindo boas práticas em identidade, criptografia, monitoramento e resposta a incidentes;
  • Governança e Políticas: Estruturar e revisar normas, políticas e procedimentos de InfoSec, assegurando sua aplicação em toda a companhia;
  • Integração com o Negócio: Atuar junto a stakeholders internos e externos (clientes, parceiros e auditores) para demonstrar a maturidade do programa de segurança.

Requisitos

  • Experiência como Tech Manager, Security Lead ou correlata em empresas de tecnologia SaaS;
  • Conhecimento em ISO 27001, LGPD, gestão de riscos, auditorias e SoA;
  • Vivência com gestão de equipes técnicas, incluindo contratação, feedbacks, desenvolvimento e desligamentos;
  • Proficiência técnica em arquitetura de segurança de sistemas web e cloud (identidade, IAM, criptografia, monitoramento, incident response);
  • Experiência em traduzir requisitos regulatórios e de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis;
  • Familiaridade com gestão de fornecedores de segurança e acompanhamento de contratos/SLAs.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Certificações de mercado: CISSP, CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 LA/LI;
  • Experiência prática com DevSecOps e integração de segurança em pipelines de desenvolvimento;
  • Atuação prévia em empresas SaaS da área fiscal/financeira;
  • Experiência em FinOps aplicado à segurança, com otimização de custos de ferramentas e licenças;

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros;
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto;
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados da empresa (PPR) competitivo com o mercado;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos;
  • Ajuda de custo ao qiver nos 03 primeiros meses após o nascimento ou adoção no valor de R$ 1.000,00 adiantados;
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 06 anos de idade;
  • Total Pass;
  • Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios;
  • Seguro de vida.

E mais

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país;
  • Enviamos todos os equipamentos necessários para montar o seu escritório em casa, mas se você preferir temos uma sede com estacionamento gratuito, lanches e bebidas liberadas e um ambiente super descontraído.
  • Ambiente de aprendizado e desenvolvimento constante, incentivando o crescimento individual, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe;
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar, por isso temos aulas online e gratuitas de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral;
  • Pensando na saúde mental e no desenvolvimento, também temos parceiros como Ana Health, Vamos Escrever e Cambly.

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive

Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir e sentir em seu dia a dia as experiências positivas apresentadas pela Qive! Isso é mais do que resolver uma dor em comum, queremos ser melhores sempre, queremos mudar o jogo seja ele qual for. E contamos com você para fazer a diferença e isso independe de sua crença, gênero, orientação sexual, cor de pele, deficiência ou classe social.

Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais

Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga (o que inclui tanto os dados informados em cada campo do formulário, quanto os que estiverem presentes no currículo anexado) e dados que podem ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. A Qive não terá acesso a nenhum outro dado que esteja fora destas hipóteses. A finalidade de coleta é tão somente para identificação, comunicação e análise das pessoas candidatas.

Informamos ainda que realizamos toda a gestão das vagas por meio do sistema InHire, não possuindo vínculo com outras plataformas em que as nossas vagas são espelhadas. Logo, caso você esteja se candidatando às nossas vagas por um meio que não seja o nosso site oficial ou pela InHire, recomenda-se a leitura dos termos e políticas próprias de cada um.

Em caso de dúvidas sobre dados pessoais, entre em contato através dos meios informados em nossa Política de Privacidade.

description:
Finance Transformation Automation Associate

Join to apply for the Finance Transformation Automation Associate role at dLocal

Overview

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets. By joining us you will be part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives.

What’s the opportunity?

  • We are seeking a Finance Transformation Automation Associate to drive the automation of financial and operational reconciliations. This role involves integrating data sources from banks and processors (APIs, SFTP, email), standardizing controls, and systematizing variance analysis to accelerate closes and reduce rework. The role blends financial–operational knowledge with skills in data ingestion services, and secure connectivity to move and validate data at scale. Success requires strong proficiency in Excel, familiarity with SQL and Python, and a strong focus on continuous improvement in an agile, fast-paced environment.

What will I be doing?

  • Integrate and maintain data sources from banks/processors via APIs, SFTP, and email workflows, ensuring data quality, completeness, and traceability
  • Execute and improve reconciliation controls for the different types of transactions supported by dashboards, matching rules, and audit evidence
  • Prepare and cleanse inputs (reconcilable groups, rules, sweeps), coordinating adjustments and new implementations with responsible teams
  • Analyze variances and differences across banks, processors, and internal records; conduct root-cause analysis and propose remedial actions and automation solutions
  • Develop analytical models (pivot tables, lookups; Power Query/Power Pivot, or equivalent) for KPIs, variance monitoring, and control tracking
  • Manage tickets and workflows in Jira for new reconciliations, rule/sweep changes, file uploads/removals, following strong documentation practices
  • Collaborate with Business Assurance, Operations, Treasury, Accounting, Product, and Data to resolve incidents, capture requirements, and coordinate UAT for new integrations
  • Standardize SOPs, strengthen controls, and scale end-to-end automations to reduce manual work, and rework during closes
  • Support multiple projects simultaneously in an agile context: gathering requirements, coordinating with stakeholders, performing UAT, and managing change

What skills do I need?

  • 2-4+ years in Finance Transformation, Treasury, Finance Operations, Engineering, or Process Automation, ideally within payments, fintech, or banking
  • Advanced Excel proficiency
  • Experience with SQL, Python and automation, with a track record of implementing tech-driven solutions
  • Experience with data ingestion and secure connectivity: APIs, SFTP, CSV/JSON; familiarity with VPN and SSH keys
  • Experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI) is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, ability to context-switch across multiple projects
  • Growth mindset with high adaptability, comfort with change, and an agile way of working
  • Excellent documentation and organizational skills
  • Fluent in spoken and written English

What do we offer?

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe*
  • Flexibility: flexible schedules and performance-driven culture
  • Fintech industry: dynamic environment with opportunities to build and boost creativity
  • Referral bonus program: employees can refer candidates and earn rewards
  • Learning & development: Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: monthly budget to engage with your team
  • dLocal Houses: option to rent a house and work remotely with your team
  • Location note: for Montevideo-based roles, attendance requirement at the office is 55% (not applicable to IT and Fraud roles)

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team will keep you posted by email at every step of the process.

Additional information

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are primarily Mac environments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.

You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta). You will create solution documentation and automation to reduce manual work. You will manage incidents and tickets, prioritize workload, and participate in projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn: 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite). Automation skills (bash, zsh, python). Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.). Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows, and work with APIs to connect systems. Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs. Excellent written and verbal communication across media. Ability to draft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages. Comfort with security principles and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model). Self-management with the ability to scope work and coordinate across teams. Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

What We Provide

Comprehensive total rewards package, remote-friendly with up to 180 days remote eligibility (subject to restrictions); ownership in the company through equity; a purpose-driven career; inclusive, diverse, and equal opportunity employer. We welcome accommodation requests via email for recruitment process stages; responses are confidential.

Company and Hiring Notes

Ledn’s team is global, remote-first, with presence across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.
